canonical_data: Convex tables for messages, tiered memory records with embeddings, execution agents and their logs, automations and runs, drafts, usage, and settings
strengths: The dispatcher is denied web, shell, and file tools, so real work happens only in scoped sub-agents that load just the integrations named at spawn
Memory has tiers, decay, a daily propose-and-judge consolidation pass, and an embedding index, with every write and sub-agent step logged to a debug dashboard
A heartbeat fails stuck sub-agents and the dashboard can cancel or retry them
weaknesses: The README calls it a starting point and a template rather than a finished product, and warns that it is not optimised for cost or security
Sub-agents run with bypassPermissions, and draft-before-send is enforced by the system prompt and tool routing rather than by a hard gate on the underlying send tools

The agent loop runs on the Claude Agent SDK or the Codex app-server under the user's own subscription terms, and memory, messaging, and integrations depend on the hosted Convex, Sendblue, and Composio services
The latest commit is from July 2026 and the package version is 0.2.0
why_it_matters: A readable end-to-end example of a messaging-first personal agent that separates a tool-less dispatcher from scoped workers and keeps long-lived memory, schedules, and approvals in one store.
